Asonde Kazu Suuji.name: Asonde Kazu Suuji
Asonde Kazu Suuji.summary: Asonde Kazu Suuji is an educational game similar to the Kids Station or Lightspan game series, in which the young kids can learn mathematics. This time the game allows the young players to learn about numbers, quantities, how to read the clock, big numbers up to 1000, how to arrange numbers, etc. meanwhile they are playing cute mini games with 8 different animal characters as their host and 5 difficulty levels in each of them.

Boxing.name: Boxing
Boxing.summary: The aptly-title Boxing is a relatively simple budget boxing game. The game offers an arcade-style boxing experience with ten colorful characters to choose from. Three modes are available: Ranking Mode, which has you fighting to become the top ranked boxer in the world; Scout Mode, which has you seeking new talent in order to unlock characters; and Battle Mode, where two players can fight an exhibition match against each other.

Dragon Ball - Final Bout.name: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout
Dragon Ball - Final Bout.summary: After achieving cult hit status around the globe, Dragon Ball GT has finally arrived in the U.S. This polygon rendered fighting game features 10 of the best warriors from the animated television series going head-to-head in a no-holds-barred tournament. Each player has devastating finishing moves, including the infamous "Meteor Smash", which can be countered by an opponent, resulting in some of the most incredible power struggles you'll ever see! There are also 8 playable hidden characters and a practice mode that lets you build up the skills of each fighter. Now, you can find out what gamers around the world already know -- Dragon Ball GT is the ultimate fighting game!

East End x Yuri - Eexy Life.name: Eexy Life: East End X Yuri
East End x Yuri - Eexy Life.summary: East End x Yuri / Eexy Life is a Playstation game based on the group that allows the player to listen to their songs, watch videos and live footage, and the game features also a digital interactive comic.

Gunfighter - The Legend of Jesse James.name: Gunfighter: The Legend of Jesse James
Gunfighter - The Legend of Jesse James.summary: Step into the boots of a legend of the Old West for a sharp-shooting adventure of true romance and frontier justice. Jesse James' partner has been shot dead and his best girl Zee has been kidnapped by a band of no-good outlaw varmints. Guide the rogue hero as he blasts away at the bad guys to avenge his lost companion and save the girl. The game is compatible with PlayStation light guns for a true first-person experience. Gunfighter: The Legend of Jesse James also features an assortment of mini-games for variety and replay value.

Iwatobi Penguin Rocky x Hopper.name: Iwatobi Penguin Rocky x Hopper
Iwatobi Penguin Rocky x Hopper.summary: Enjoy party games with the brother penguins Rocky & Hopper. Norinori Classics Super 70's dance music BGM to six! If you choose Raburabumodo, with a multi-tap controller in two pieces at a time up to four people can play!

Koko Hore! Pukka.name: Kokohore! Pukka: Dig-a-Dig Pukka
Koko Hore! Pukka.summary:
A digital pet (also known as a virtual pet or artificial pet is a type of artificial human companion. They are usually kept for companionship or enjoyment. People may keep a digital pet in lieu of a real pet.

Digital pets can be "simulations of real animals, as in the Petz series" or "fantasy ones like the Tamagotchi". Unlike biological simulations, the pet does not usually reproduce. They generally do not die.

In Dig a-Dig Pukka (Kokohore! Pukka: Dig a-Dig Pukka) the player controls a miner robotic pet that will explore the lands searching for rare minerals and gems. In his jobs he will be rewarded by his founds with money that the player can use to buy new objects and tools.

Midori no Makibao - Kuroi Inazuma Shiroi.name: Midori No Makibao: Kuroi Inazuma Shiroi Kiseki
Midori no Makibao - Kuroi Inazuma Shiroi.summary:
Midori no Makibao is an anime based Playstation game who is a mix between an adventure mode and a racing mode. The adventure part is a choice of different actions and the horse racing part is in third person perspective and the gameplay is just pressing the proper buttons in the proper way to run faster.
It also features 2D & Cartoon graphics and this game is 1 Player experience only!

Naniwa Wangan Battle - Tarzan Yamada & A.name: Naniwa Wangan Battle
Naniwa Wangan Battle - Tarzan Yamada & A.summary:
A racing videogame released only in Japan for the Sony Playstation in 1998.
It is set in Wangan-sen, a famous stretch of highway in Greater Tokyo.

Odo Odo Oddity.name: Odo Odo Oddity
Odo Odo Oddity.summary: The gameplay is a classic 3d shooter in which the player controls a character that can shoot magic balls while traveling with the aid of some balloons.

Shin Senki Van-Gale - The War of Neo-Cen.name: Van-Gale: The War of Neo-Century
Shin Senki Van-Gale - The War of Neo-Cen.summary: Van-Gale: The War of Neo-Century is an Action game, developed by Aroma and published by Yumedia, which was released in Japan in 1997.

Simple 1500 Series Vol. 100 - The Uchuu.name: Simple 1500 Series Vol. 100: The Uchuu Hikoushi
Simple 1500 Series Vol. 100 - The Uchuu.summary: The Uchuu Hikoushi is a 3D action game that features a complete gravity simulation in which the player controls an astronaut in the future that have to complete several missions through the game in space stations or outside dangerous planets.

Street Racquetball.name: Street Racquetball
Street Racquetball.summary:
Street Racquetball is one of very few console games featuring the enclosed sport of racquetball, though the first title devoted to the sport, Racquetball, was released in 1981 for the Atari Video Computer System. A1 Games' history of released sports related games includes tennis, boxing, bowling, kickboxing, snowboarding, racing and more.

As in indoor racquetball courts, Street Racquetball's "outdoor" courts contain two sidewalls, a front wall, serving zones, and a receiving line -- but no ceiling. Players can opt for exhibition mode (against the computer), challenge mode (unlock new characters and courts by winning three consecutive matches), training mode (continuous rally solo play), or two-player VS mode. Three difficulty settings offer "easy," "normal." or "hard" gameplay, ball bounce levels can be adjusted to "low," "middle," or "high," and the eight computer-controlled opponents are rated in performance level, type of game, power, speed, and skill. Shots include slams, lobs, and drop shots.

VR Soccer '96.name: VR Soccer
VR Soccer '96.summary:
VR Soccer (sometimes referred to as VR Soccer '96, and known as Actua Soccer in Japan and Europe) is a sports video game developed and published by Gremlin Interactive for MS-DOS, PlayStation, Sega Saturn.

This was the first sports video game to include a full 3D graphics engine. For the animations of the players, 3 players of the club Sheffield Wednesday served as motion capture models.

Actua Soccer contains only 44 national teams, each containing 22 players. However, in 1996 a new version containing clubs was released: Actua Soccer: Club Edition. It contained 20 Premier League teams from the 1996/1997 season. It became a best seller in Europe, mainly in the United Kingdom.
